title: Local étale representatives for finite-level Isom sections
statement: Under the bounded finite-lisse, fixed-realization comparison, and local model hypotheses of the finite-level descent theorem, every geometric point of the etale base has an etale neighbourhood carrying an actual derived isomorphism from the normalized constant model to the supplied etale complex.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV, local comparison and Isom presheaf sections.

proof.text: First obtain the pointwise pro-etale derived Isom sections from the finite-level comparison and model sieve. Then apply the generic etale representative theorem to turn each such section into an actual derived isomorphism on an etale neighbourhood carrying the chosen geometric point.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV; decomposed into pro-etale section construction and etale representative extraction.

lean.statement: theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_local_isomorphisms (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n)))) (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))) (D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))) (hDbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) (hDlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) (hcomparison : Nonempty ((lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj D) ≅ (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧ ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w → Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅ (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left), ∃ (V : U.left.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj V), Nonempty ((localIsomorphismRestriction U.left (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n) V).obj ((normalizationConstant U.left.smallEtaleTopology).obj E) ≅ (localIsomorphismRestriction U.left (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n) V).obj D)
